verdict.rationale: The evidence contains no vendor-maintained migration guide or tool for moving users off a competing auth provider, and nothing on importing existing password hashes to avoid forced resets. Realm JSON import/export covers Keycloak's own configuration, and the 'implement your own provider' user-federation hook is a developer building block. One community user found leaving Auth0 'fairly easy', but that is an anecdote, not first-party tooling, so none of these earn credit.
